goal: Known harness event kinds render in the session transcript as short human phrases built from payload fields, while unknown kinds keep the existing kind-plus-JSON-digest rendering unchanged.

references: Spec FR-4 acceptance: harness.iteration_completed with iteration 3 and total_tokens 1200 renders as a phrase containing 'iteration 3' and a token count, with no braces

Emitted kinds to cover at minimum: harness.iteration_completed, harness.awaiting_approval, harness.control_command_applied, harness.control_command_failed, harness.attempt_started, harness.attempt_finalized, harness.retry_scheduled; other harness.* kinds (blocked, unblocked, interrupted, stuck, hang_detected, thrash_detected, budget_exceeded, context_threshold_crossed, context_recovery, manual_approved, manual_rejected, rubric_invoked, rubric_verdict, crash) may be added where the payload makes a clear phrase, and anything unrecognized falls back to the JSON digest
constraints: A formatter receiving a known kind with missing or oddly shaped payload fields falls back to the JSON digest for that record; it never raises
No event kind is hidden or suppressed; every record still produces a transcript entry

control_command_applied/failed entries must keep populating control_command_id and control_command_error exactly as today so SessionScreen._reconcile_pending keeps flipping pending markers; the pending-transition tests in packages/flywheel/tests/test_session_screen.py (test_session_screen_pending_to_applied_transition, test_session_screen_pending_to_failed_surfaces_error_detail) must stay green
Gate classification (harness.awaiting_approval producing EntryKind.GATE) keeps its current behavior; only the visible wording may improve

Tests pinning the old digest rendering must be updated in the same commit: packages/flywheel/tests/test_session.py::test_classify_lifecycle_event_uses_kind_as_header and test_classify_non_say_control_event_renders_generic_control_line
Add test coverage for the FR-4 acceptance: a known kind renders a brace-free phrase and an unrecognized kind still shows its JSON digest
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No changes to event emission in flywheel-core; formatting is read-side only
Do not touch the flywheel_core.audit CLI line format
No timestamp, spacing, or style-map work (final task in this phase)
edge_cases: harness.control_command_failed must surface error_type and message in the phrase
Non-JSON-serializable payloads keep the existing _payload_digest fallback
